webhooks.detail: Webhooks fire on store data changes (order.created, product.updated, customer.created, application.installed, etc.), each gated by an access scope; single webhook URL per app, signature header, 24h retries.

evidence.quote: Webhooks are triggered by any changes in the store data, no matter their source.

sandbox.detail: API only works on paid plans. No self-serve free sandbox; developers email support to get a free plan upgrade for a test store.

evidence.quote: Email us to get a free plan upgrade for your test store.

rate_limits.summary: 600 requests/min per token; HTTP 429 with Retry-After header when exceeded

evidence.quote: We accept up to 600 requests per minute per token.
